---
title: "Atlas"
subtitle: "Explore how California water-data innovation has evolved across place, time, and theme."
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

<style>
  .atlas-shell {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    font-family: inherit;
  }
  .atlas-controls {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
  }
  .atlas-control {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
  }
  .atlas-control label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .atlas-control input,
  .atlas-control select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.58rem 0.7rem;
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .atlas-section {
    margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .atlas-section h2 {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
  .atlas-who-panel {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(340px, 1.5fr) minmax(260px, 0.9fr);
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  .atlas-network-wrap {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 380px;
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .atlas-network-wrap svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }
  .atlas-network-sidebar {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.7rem;
  }
  .atlas-network-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.55rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .atlas-btn {
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .atlas-btn:hover,
  .atlas-btn:focus-visible {
    border-color: #2563eb;
    outline: none;
  }
  .atlas-network-details {
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 0.85rem;
    background: #fff;
    min-height: 290px;
  }
  .atlas-network-details h3 {
    margin: 0 0 0.45rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .atlas-network-meta {
    font-size: 0.84rem;
    color: #4b5563;
    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  }
  .atlas-network-list {
    margin: 0.4rem 0 0;
    padding-left: 1rem;
    max-height: 190px;
    overflow: auto;
  }
  .atlas-network-list li {
    margin: 0.2rem 0;
  }
  .atlas-edge {
    stroke: #cbd5e1;
    stroke-width: 1.2;
    opacity: 0.65;
  }
  .atlas-edge.active {
    stroke: #2563eb;
    stroke-width: 2;
    opacity: 0.95;
  }
  .atlas-node {
    cursor: pointer;
    stroke-width: 1.2;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
  }
  .atlas-node.entity {
    fill: #16a34a;
    stroke: #166534;
  }
  .atlas-node.project {
    fill: #2563eb;
    stroke: #1d4ed8;
  }
  .atlas-node.dimmed {
    opacity: 0.2;
  }
  .atlas-node.active {
    stroke: #111827;
    stroke-width: 2.2;
  }
  .atlas-node-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    fill: #111827;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .atlas-node-label.dimmed {
    opacity: 0.25;
  }
  .atlas-chip {
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 0.2rem 0.35rem 0.2rem 0;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #edf4ff;
    color: #1f2937;
    border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  .atlas-chip.active {
    background: #2563eb;
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #2563eb;
  }
  .atlas-timeline {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.9rem;
    min-height: 220px;
    padding: 1.25rem 0.75rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  }
  .atlas-bar-wrap {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    min-width: 52px;
    height: 190px;
  }
  .atlas-bar {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 56px;
    min-height: 8px;
    background: #6a86a9;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, opacity 0.18s ease;
    opacity: 0.95;
  }
  .atlas-bar:hover,
  .atlas-bar:focus-visible {
    background: #4f6f96;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    outline: none;
  }
  .atlas-bar.active {
    background: #3c5b84;
  }
  .atlas-bar-label {
    margin-top: 0.6rem;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: #4b5563;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .atlas-bar-count {
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    color: #374151;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .atlas-keywords {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 0.7rem;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 180px;
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #f8fafc;
  }
  .atlas-word {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
    color: #1f2937;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  .atlas-results {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  .atlas-card {
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .atlas-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 0.45rem;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
  }
  .atlas-meta {
    font-size: 0.84rem;
    color: #4b5563;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }
  .atlas-card p {
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0.75rem;
  }
  .atlas-empty {
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    color: #374151;
  }
  .atlas-note {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: #4b5563;
    margin-top: 0.75rem;
  }
</style>

<div class="atlas-shell">
<p><strong>Explore how California water-data innovation has evolved across place, time, and theme.</strong></p>

<div class="atlas-controls">
<div class="atlas-control">
<label for="atlas-year-filter">Year</label>
<select id="atlas-year-filter">
<option value="all">All years</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="atlas-control">
<label for="atlas-topic-filter">Topic</label>
<select id="atlas-topic-filter">
<option value="all">All topics</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="atlas-control">
<label for="atlas-location-filter">Location</label>
<select id="atlas-location-filter">
<option value="all">All locations</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="atlas-control">
<label for="atlas-search">Search</label>
<input id="atlas-search" type="text" placeholder="Search projects, teams, topics" />
</div>
</div>

<div class="atlas-section">
<h2>WHO — Explore the Ecosystem</h2>
<div class="atlas-who-panel">
<div id="atlas-network" class="atlas-network-wrap"></div>
<div class="atlas-network-sidebar">
<div class="atlas-network-controls">
<button id="atlas-network-reset" class="atlas-btn" type="button">Reset selection</button>
</div>
<div id="atlas-network-details" class="atlas-network-details"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="atlas-note">This view shows documented entity-to-project associations from available source fields. It does not infer entity-to-entity collaboration.</div>
</div>

<div class="atlas-section">
<h2>WHEN — Explore by Time</h2>
<div id="atlas-timeline" class="atlas-timeline"></div>
</div>

<div class="atlas-section">
<h2>WHAT — Explore by Theme</h2>
<div id="atlas-keywords" class="atlas-keywords"></div>
</div>

<div class="atlas-section">
<h2>Projects</h2>
<div id="atlas-results" class="atlas-results"></div>
</div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const state = {
    allProjects: [],
    year: 'all',
    topic: 'all',
    location: 'all',
    keyword: 'all',
    search: '',
    selectedEntity: null,
    selectedProjectId: null,
    includeIndividuals: false
  };

  const yearFilter = document.getElementById('atlas-year-filter');
  const topicFilter = document.getElementById('atlas-topic-filter');
  const locationFilter = document.getElementById('atlas-location-filter');
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('atlas-search');
  const networkEl = document.getElementById('atlas-network');
  const networkDetailsEl = document.getElementById('atlas-network-details');
  const networkResetBtn = document.getElementById('atlas-network-reset');
  const timelineEl = document.getElementById('atlas-timeline');
  const keywordsEl = document.getElementById('atlas-keywords');
  const resultsEl = document.getElementById('atlas-results');

  function normalizeProject(project) {
    const topicList = Array.isArray(project.topic_list)
      ? project.topic_list
      : (String(project.topics || '')
          .split('|')
          .map(v => v.replace(/['"]/g, '').replace(/^Topic:\s*/i, '').trim())
          .filter(Boolean));
    const keywordList = Array.isArray(project.keywords)
      ? project.keywords
      : (Array.isArray(project.keyword_list) ? project.keyword_list : []);
    const relationshipList = Array.isArray(project.entity_relationships)
      ? project.entity_relationships
      : [];

    return {
      ...project,
      year: project.year ? Number(project.year) : null,
      topic_list: topicList,
      keywords: keywordList,
      keyword_list: keywordList,
      entity_role: project.entity_role || '',
      entity_relationships: relationshipList,
      location: project.spatial_category || 'California statewide',
      description: (project.description || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      team: project.team_name || project.team_members || 'Unknown team'
    };
  }

  function uniqueSorted(values) {
    return Array.from(new Set(values.filter(Boolean))).sort();
  }

  function filterProjects() {
    const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return state.allProjects.filter(project => {
      const yearOk = state.year === 'all' || String(project.year) === String(state.year);
      const topicOk = state.topic === 'all' || project.topic_list.includes(state.topic);
      const locationOk = state.location === 'all' || project.location === state.location;
      const projectKeywords = Array.isArray(project.keywords) ? project.keywords : [];
      const keywordOk = state.keyword === 'all' || projectKeywords.includes(state.keyword);
      const searchText = [project.title, project.team, project.description, project.topic_list.join(' '), project.event, projectKeywords.join(' ')].join(' ').toLowerCase();
      const textOk = !q || searchText.includes(q);
      return yearOk && topicOk && locationOk && keywordOk && textOk;
    });
  }

  function cleanEntityName(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();
  }

  function normalizeEntityType(entityTypeRaw) {
    const value = String(entityTypeRaw || '').trim();
    return value || 'Unknown';
  }

  function getProjectRelationships(project) {
    const rels = Array.isArray(project.entity_relationships) ? project.entity_relationships : [];
    const filtered = rels.filter(rel => {
      const name = cleanEntityName(rel.entity_name || '');
      if (!name) return false;
      const type = normalizeEntityType(rel.entity_type);
      if (!state.includeIndividuals && type === 'Individual') return false;
      return true;
    });

    const dedup = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    filtered.forEach(rel => {
      const name = cleanEntityName(rel.entity_name || '');
      const role = String(rel.entity_role || '').trim();
      const src = String(rel.source_field || '').trim();
      const key = `${name}||${role}||${src}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) return;
      seen.add(key);
      dedup.push({
        entity_name: name,
        entity_type: normalizeEntityType(rel.entity_type),
        entity_role: role,
        source_field: src,
        evidence: String(rel.evidence || '').trim(),
        project_id: rel.project_id || project.id,
        project_title: rel.project_title || project.title,
        year: rel.year || project.year
      });
    });
    return dedup;
  }

  function buildNetwork(projects) {
    const entities = new Map();
    const projectNodes = [];
    const links = [];

    projects.forEach(project => {
      const pid = String(project.id);
      projectNodes.push({
        id: `project:${pid}`,
        projectId: pid,
        type: 'project',
        label: project.title || 'Untitled project',
        project
      });

      const relationships = getProjectRelationships(project);
      relationships.forEach(rel => {
        const entityName = rel.entity_name;
        if (!entities.has(entityName)) {
          entities.set(entityName, {
            id: `entity:${entityName}`,
            name: entityName,
            type: 'entity',
            entityType: rel.entity_type || 'Unknown',
            projects: new Set(),
            roles: new Set(),
            sourceFields: new Set(),
            evidence: new Set()
          });
        }
        const entityNode = entities.get(entityName);
        entityNode.projects.add(pid);
        if (rel.entity_role) entityNode.roles.add(rel.entity_role);
        if (rel.source_field) entityNode.sourceFields.add(rel.source_field);
        if (rel.evidence) entityNode.evidence.add(rel.evidence);

        links.push({
          id: `link:${entityName}::${pid}`,
          source: entityNode.id,
          target: `project:${pid}`,
          entityName,
          projectId: pid,
          sourceField: rel.source_field,
          evidence: rel.evidence,
          entityRole: rel.entity_role
        });
      });
    });

    const entityNodes = Array.from(entities.values()).map(node => ({
      ...node,
      projectCount: node.projects.size,
      roleText: Array.from(node.roles).join(' | '),
      sourceFieldsText: Array.from(node.sourceFields).join(' | '),
      evidenceList: Array.from(node.evidence).slice(0, 8)
    }));

    return {
      entityNodes: entityNodes.sort((a, b) => b.projectCount - a.projectCount || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
      projectNodes,
      links
    };
  }

  function renderNetworkDetails(selection, network, baseProjects) {
    if (!selection) {
      networkDetailsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Select an entity or project in the network to inspect documented associations.</div>';
      return;
    }

    if (selection.kind === 'entity') {
      const entity = network.entityNodes.find(n => n.name === selection.value);
      if (!entity) {
        networkDetailsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Selected entity is not available in the current filter context.</div>';
        return;
      }
      const relatedProjects = baseProjects
        .filter(p => entity.projects.has(String(p.id)))
        .sort((a, b) => (a.year || 0) - (b.year || 0));
      const years = Array.from(new Set(relatedProjects.map(p => p.year).filter(Boolean))).sort((a, b) => a - b);

      networkDetailsEl.innerHTML = `
        <h3>${entity.name}</h3>
        <div class="atlas-network-meta">Type: ${entity.entityType}</div>
        <div class="atlas-network-meta">Associated projects: ${relatedProjects.length}</div>
        <div class="atlas-network-meta">Years represented: ${years.length ? years.join(', ') : 'Unknown'}</div>
        ${entity.roleText ? `<div class="atlas-network-meta">Roles: ${entity.roleText}</div>` : ''}
        ${entity.sourceFieldsText ? `<div class="atlas-network-meta">Source fields: ${entity.sourceFieldsText}</div>` : ''}
        <strong>Related projects</strong>
        <ul class="atlas-network-list">
          ${relatedProjects.map(p => `<li>${p.title || 'Untitled project'}${p.year ? ` (${p.year})` : ''}</li>`).join('')}
        </ul>
      `;
      return;
    }

    const project = baseProjects.find(p => String(p.id) === String(selection.value));
    if (!project) {
      networkDetailsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Selected project is not available in the current filter context.</div>';
      return;
    }
    const connectedEntities = network.entityNodes
      .filter(e => e.projects.has(String(project.id)))
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    networkDetailsEl.innerHTML = `
      <h3>${project.title || 'Untitled project'}</h3>
      <div class="atlas-network-meta">Status: ${project.status || 'Unknown'}</div>
      <div class="atlas-network-meta">Year: ${project.year || 'Unknown'}</div>
      <div class="atlas-network-meta">Associated entities: ${connectedEntities.length}</div>
      <strong>Associated entities</strong>
      <ul class="atlas-network-list">
        ${connectedEntities.map(e => `<li>${e.name} <span class="atlas-network-meta">(${e.entityType})</span></li>`).join('')}
      </ul>
    `;
  }

  function renderWhoNetwork(baseProjects) {
    const network = buildNetwork(baseProjects);

    if (state.selectedEntity && !network.entityNodes.some(n => n.name === state.selectedEntity)) {
      state.selectedEntity = null;
    }
    if (state.selectedProjectId && !network.projectNodes.some(n => n.projectId === String(state.selectedProjectId))) {
      state.selectedProjectId = null;
    }

    if (!network.entityNodes.length && !network.projectNodes.length) {
      networkEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">No ecosystem associations are available for the current filters.</div>';
      renderNetworkDetails(null, network, baseProjects);
      return;
    }

    const width = 960;
    const rowHeight = 30;
    const marginTop = 26;
    const entityX = 220;
    const projectX = 740;

    const entityNodes = network.entityNodes;
    const projectNodes = network.projectNodes.sort((a, b) => (a.project.year || 0) - (b.project.year || 0) || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
    const count = Math.max(entityNodes.length, projectNodes.length);
    const height = Math.max(380, marginTop * 2 + count * rowHeight);

    const entityPos = new Map();
    entityNodes.forEach((node, idx) => entityPos.set(node.id, { x: entityX, y: marginTop + idx * rowHeight + 16 }));
    const projectPos = new Map();
    projectNodes.forEach((node, idx) => projectPos.set(node.id, { x: projectX, y: marginTop + idx * rowHeight + 16 }));

    const hasSelection = !!(state.selectedEntity || state.selectedProjectId);
    const activeProjectIds = new Set();
    const activeEntityNames = new Set();
    if (state.selectedEntity) {
      activeEntityNames.add(state.selectedEntity);
      const entity = entityNodes.find(n => n.name === state.selectedEntity);
      if (entity) entity.projects.forEach(pid => activeProjectIds.add(String(pid)));
    }
    if (state.selectedProjectId) {
      activeProjectIds.add(String(state.selectedProjectId));
      entityNodes.forEach(node => {
        if (node.projects.has(String(state.selectedProjectId))) activeEntityNames.add(node.name);
      });
    }

    const linkSvg = network.links.map(link => {
      const s = entityPos.get(link.source);
      const t = projectPos.get(link.target);
      if (!s || !t) return '';
      const active = state.selectedEntity
        ? (link.entityName === state.selectedEntity)
        : (state.selectedProjectId ? String(link.projectId) === String(state.selectedProjectId) : false);
      const dimmed = hasSelection && !active;
      return `<line class="atlas-edge ${active ? 'active' : ''} ${dimmed ? 'dimmed' : ''}" x1="${s.x}" y1="${s.y}" x2="${t.x}" y2="${t.y}" />`;
    }).join('');

    const entitySvg = entityNodes.map(node => {
      const p = entityPos.get(node.id);
      const active = activeEntityNames.has(node.name);
      const dimmed = hasSelection && !active;
      const r = Math.max(6, Math.min(14, 5 + node.projectCount * 1.2));
      const label = node.name.length > 34 ? `${node.name.slice(0, 31)}…` : node.name;
      return `
        <g data-entity="${node.name.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}">
          <circle class="atlas-node entity ${active ? 'active' : ''} ${dimmed ? 'dimmed' : ''}" cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" r="${r}" />
          <text class="atlas-node-label ${dimmed ? 'dimmed' : ''}" x="${p.x - 10}" y="${p.y + 4}" text-anchor="end">${label}</text>
        </g>
      `;
    }).join('');

    const projectSvg = projectNodes.map(node => {
      const p = projectPos.get(node.id);
      const active = activeProjectIds.has(String(node.projectId));
      const dimmed = hasSelection && !active;
      const degree = entityNodes.filter(e => e.projects.has(String(node.projectId))).length;
      const r = Math.max(5, Math.min(12, 4 + degree * 1.5));
      const label = node.label.length > 38 ? `${node.label.slice(0, 35)}…` : node.label;
      return `
        <g data-project-id="${String(node.projectId)}">
          <circle class="atlas-node project ${active ? 'active' : ''} ${dimmed ? 'dimmed' : ''}" cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" r="${r}" />
          <text class="atlas-node-label ${dimmed ? 'dimmed' : ''}" x="${p.x + 10}" y="${p.y + 4}" text-anchor="start">${label}</text>
        </g>
      `;
    }).join('');

    networkEl.innerHTML = `
      <svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" role="img" aria-label="Entity to project ecosystem network">
        <text x="80" y="20" font-size="12" fill="#374151" font-weight="600">Entities</text>
        <text x="790" y="20" font-size="12" fill="#374151" font-weight="600">Projects</text>
        ${linkSvg}
        ${entitySvg}
        ${projectSvg}
      </svg>
    `;

    networkEl.querySelectorAll('[data-entity]').forEach(group => {
      group.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const entityName = group.getAttribute('data-entity');
        state.selectedEntity = state.selectedEntity === entityName ? null : entityName;
        state.selectedProjectId = null;
        renderAll();
      });
    });

    networkEl.querySelectorAll('[data-project-id]').forEach(group => {
      group.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const pid = group.getAttribute('data-project-id');
        state.selectedProjectId = state.selectedProjectId === pid ? null : pid;
        state.selectedEntity = null;
        renderAll();
      });
    });

    const selection = state.selectedEntity
      ? { kind: 'entity', value: state.selectedEntity }
      : (state.selectedProjectId ? { kind: 'project', value: state.selectedProjectId } : null);
    renderNetworkDetails(selection, network, baseProjects);
  }

  function applyNetworkSelection(projects) {
    if (state.selectedEntity) {
      return projects.filter(project => getProjectRelationships(project).some(rel => rel.entity_name === state.selectedEntity));
    }
    if (state.selectedProjectId) {
      return projects.filter(project => String(project.id) === String(state.selectedProjectId));
    }
    return projects;
  }

  function renderControls() {
    const years = uniqueSorted(state.allProjects.map(p => p.year).filter(v => v !== null)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    yearFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All years</option>' + years.map(y => `<option value="${y}">${y}</option>`).join('');
    yearFilter.value = state.year;

    const topics = uniqueSorted(state.allProjects.flatMap(p => p.topic_list));
    topicFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All topics</option>' + topics.map(t => `<option value="${t}">${t}</option>`).join('');
    topicFilter.value = state.topic;

    const locations = uniqueSorted(state.allProjects.map(p => p.location));
    locationFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All locations</option>' + locations.map(l => `<option value="${l}">${l}</option>`).join('');
    locationFilter.value = state.location;
  }

  function renderTimeline(projects) {
    const countsByYear = {};
    projects.forEach(project => {
      if (project.year) countsByYear[project.year] = (countsByYear[project.year] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const years = Object.keys(countsByYear).map(Number).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const maxCount = years.length ? Math.max(...years.map(y => countsByYear[y])) : 0;

    if (!years.length) {
      timelineEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">No projects match the selected filters.</div>';
      return;
    }

    timelineEl.innerHTML = years.map(year => {
      const count = countsByYear[year];
      const height = maxCount ? (count / maxCount) * 140 + 10 : 10;
      const active = state.year === String(year);
      const barClass = active ? 'atlas-bar active' : 'atlas-bar';
      return `
        <div class="atlas-bar-wrap">
          <div class="atlas-bar-count">${count}</div>
          <button class="${barClass}" data-year="${year}" title="${year} — ${count} projects" style="height:${height}px;"></button>
          <div class="atlas-bar-label">${year}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');

    timelineEl.querySelectorAll('[data-year]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const next = button.dataset.year;
        state.year = state.year === next ? 'all' : next;
        renderAll();
      });
    });
  }

  function renderKeywords(projects) {
    const counts = {};
    projects.forEach(project => {
      const projectKeywords = Array.isArray(project.keywords) ? project.keywords : [];
      projectKeywords.forEach(keyword => {
        const clean = String(keyword || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!clean) return;
        counts[clean] = (counts[clean] || 0) + 1;
      });
    });

    const entries = Object.entries(counts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 24);
    if (!entries.length) {
      keywordsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">No theme keywords are available for the current selection.</div>';
      return;
    }

    const max = entries[0][1];
    keywordsEl.innerHTML = entries.map(([word, count]) => {
      const size = 0.8 + (count / max) * 1.7;
      const active = state.keyword === word ? 'background:#2563eb;color:#fff;' : '';
      return `<button class="atlas-word" data-keyword="${word}" style="font-size:${size.toFixed(2)}rem;${active}">${word}</button>`;
    }).join('');

    keywordsEl.querySelectorAll('[data-keyword]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const next = button.dataset.keyword;
        state.keyword = state.keyword === next ? 'all' : next;
        renderAll();
      });
    });
  }

  function renderResults(projects) {
    if (!projects.length) {
      resultsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">No projects match the current filters.</div>';
      return;
    }

    resultsEl.innerHTML = projects.map(project => {
      const hasProjectUrl = project.project_url && String(project.project_url).trim() !== '';
      const titleHtml = hasProjectUrl
        ? `<a href="${project.project_url}">${project.title || 'Untitled project'}</a>`
        : `${project.title || 'Untitled project'}`;
      const projectLinkHtml = hasProjectUrl
        ? `<a href="${project.project_url}">Open project page</a>`
        : '';

      return `
      <div class="atlas-card">
        <h3>${titleHtml}</h3>
        <div class="atlas-meta">${project.year || 'Unknown year'} • ${project.team || 'Unknown team'} • ${project.location || 'California statewide'}</div>
        <div class="atlas-meta">${project.topic_list.length ? project.topic_list.join(' • ') : 'No topic listed'}</div>
        <p>${project.description ? (project.description.length > 280 ? project.description.slice(0, 280) + '…' : project.description) : 'No description available.'}</p>
        ${projectLinkHtml}
      </div>
    `;
    }).join('');
  }

  function renderAll() {
    const baseFiltered = filterProjects();
    const filtered = applyNetworkSelection(baseFiltered);
    renderControls();
    renderWhoNetwork(baseFiltered);
    renderTimeline(filtered);
    renderKeywords(filtered);
    renderResults(filtered);
  }

  async function loadData() {
    const response = await fetch('atlas-projects.json');
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Atlas data is missing. Run the R script to generate docs/atlas-projects.json.');
    }
    const projects = await response.json();
    state.allProjects = (projects || []).map(normalizeProject);
    renderAll();
  }

  yearFilter.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
    state.year = event.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });
  topicFilter.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
    state.topic = event.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });
  locationFilter.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
    state.location = event.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
    state.search = event.target.value;
    renderAll();
  });

  networkResetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.selectedEntity = null;
    state.selectedProjectId = null;
    renderAll();
  });

  loadData().catch(error => {
    resultsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">' + error.message + '</div>';
    networkEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Network unavailable because the Atlas data file is missing.</div>';
    timelineEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Timeline unavailable because the Atlas data file is missing.</div>';
    keywordsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Theme cloud unavailable because the Atlas data file is missing.</div>';
    networkDetailsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="atlas-empty">Details unavailable because the Atlas data file is missing.</div>';
  });
})();
</script>

<p class="atlas-note">This MVP uses the repository’s official project workbook as the source of truth and only derives a lightweight Atlas dataset for interactive filtering and exploration. More detailed geographic footprints can be added later without altering the underlying project pages.</p>
